user.title: NovaStar TB40
user.description: Use the local IPv4 address and the serial number on the controller label. The network check tests the TCP port only and does not verify the password.

reconfigure.title: Update TB40 connection
reconfigure.description: Leave the password blank to keep the current one. The check only tests the TCP port.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach TCP port 16603. Check the address, network, and controller power.

data.night_limit: Limit nighttime startup with the solar curve disabled

send_failed.message: Could not send brightness to the TB40. Check that the controller is on and reachable.
